name: Application CI/CD
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - staging
      - main

  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  # JOB 0: RESOLVE ENVIRONMENT
  resolve:
    name: Resolve environment
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      environment: ${{ steps.set.outputs.environment }}
    steps:
      - name: Determine environment from branch
        id: set
        run: |
          if [[ "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" == "main" ]]; then
            echo "environment=production" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          else
            echo "environment=staging" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          fi

  # JOB 1: PREPARE
  prepare:
    name: Prepare deployment
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: resolve
    environment: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.environment }}

    env:
      APP_DISPLAY_NAME: ${{ vars.APP_DISPLAY_NAME }}
      APP_ROOT: ${{ vars.APP_ROOT }}
      APP_PORT: ${{ vars.APP_PORT }}
      APP_BASE_PATH: ${{ vars.APP_BASE_PATH }}
      ASG_NAME: ${{ vars.ASG_NAME }}
      AWS_REGION: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION }}
      GIT_BRANCH: ${{ vars.GIT_BRANCH }}
      PM2_APP_NAME: ${{ vars.PM2_APP_NAME }}
      REPO_URL: ${{ vars.REPO_URL }}

    outputs:
      instance_ids: ${{ steps.instances.outputs.instance_ids }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check GitHub context
        run: |
          echo "========================================"
          echo "GitHub Context"
          echo "========================================"
          echo "Repository: ${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"
          echo "Ref: ${GITHUB_REF}"
          echo "Event: ${GITHUB_EVENT_NAME}"
          echo "Commit: ${GITHUB_SHA}"
          echo "Resolved environment: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.environment }}"
          echo ""
          echo "========================================"
          echo "Application Configuration"
          echo "========================================"
          echo "Application: ${APP_DISPLAY_NAME}"
          echo "Application Root: ${APP_ROOT}"
          echo "PM2 Application: ${PM2_APP_NAME}"
          echo "Application Port: ${APP_PORT}"
          echo "Application Base Path: ${APP_BASE_PATH}"
          echo "Git Branch: ${GIT_BRANCH}"
          echo "Repo URL: ${REPO_URL}"

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v6
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Find running EC2 instances
        id: instances
        run: |
          echo "========================================"
          echo "Finding running EC2 instances"
          echo "========================================"
          echo "ASG: ${ASG_NAME}"

          INSTANCE_IDS=$(aws ec2 describe-instances \
            --filters \
              "Name=tag:aws:autoscaling:groupName,Values=${ASG_NAME}" \
              "Name=instance-state-name,Values=running" \
            --query 'Reservations[].Instances[].InstanceId' \
            --output text)

          if [[ -z "${INSTANCE_IDS}" || "${INSTANCE_IDS}" == "None" ]]; then
            echo "ERROR: No running EC2 instances found for ASG."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo ""
          echo "Target EC2 instances:"
          echo "${INSTANCE_IDS}"

          echo "instance_ids=${INSTANCE_IDS}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

  # JOB 2: PULL CODE
  pull:
    name: Pull code
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [resolve, prepare]
    environment: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.environment }}

    env:
      APP_ROOT: ${{ vars.APP_ROOT }}
      APP_CONFIG_ROOT: ${{ vars.APP_CONFIG_ROOT }}
      GIT_BRANCH: ${{ vars.GIT_BRANCH }}
      REPO_URL: ${{ vars.REPO_URL }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v6
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Pull latest code
        uses: ./.github/actions/ssm-run
        with:
          phase: Pull latest code
          instance-ids: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.instance_ids }}
          script: |
            FIRST_DEPLOY=false

            if [[ ! -d "${APP_ROOT}/.git" ]]; then
              echo "Application directory not found or not a git repo at ${APP_ROOT}."
              echo "Cloning ${GIT_BRANCH} from ${REPO_URL}..."

              mkdir -p "$(dirname "${APP_ROOT}")"
              rm -rf "${APP_ROOT}"
              git clone --branch "${GIT_BRANCH}" --single-branch "${REPO_URL}" "${APP_ROOT}"

              FIRST_DEPLOY=true
            fi

            cd "${APP_ROOT}"

            PREVIOUS_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
            echo "Previous commit: ${PREVIOUS_COMMIT}"

            NODE_MODULES_BACKUP_CREATED=false
            BUILD_BACKUP_CREATED=false

            if [[ -d node_modules ]]; then
              rm -rf "${NODE_MODULES_BACKUP}"
              mv node_modules "${NODE_MODULES_BACKUP}"
              NODE_MODULES_BACKUP_CREATED=true
              echo "node_modules backup created."
            fi

            if [[ -d .next ]]; then
              rm -rf "${BUILD_BACKUP}"
              mv .next "${BUILD_BACKUP}"
              BUILD_BACKUP_CREATED=true
              echo ".next backup created."
            fi

            if ! git fetch origin "${GIT_BRANCH}"; then
              echo "ERROR: git fetch failed. Restoring backups..."
              if [[ "${NODE_MODULES_BACKUP_CREATED}" == "true" ]]; then
                mv "${NODE_MODULES_BACKUP}" node_modules
              fi
              if [[ "${BUILD_BACKUP_CREATED}" == "true" ]]; then
                mv "${BUILD_BACKUP}" .next
              fi
              exit 1
            fi

            if ! git reset --hard "origin/${GIT_BRANCH}"; then
              echo "ERROR: git reset failed. Restoring backups..."
              if [[ "${NODE_MODULES_BACKUP_CREATED}" == "true" ]]; then
                mv "${NODE_MODULES_BACKUP}" node_modules
              fi
              if [[ "${BUILD_BACKUP_CREATED}" == "true" ]]; then
                mv "${BUILD_BACKUP}" .next
              fi
              exit 1
            fi

            git clean -fd

            echo "Current commit: $(git rev-parse HEAD)"

            echo ""
            echo "Restoring server-specific configuration..."
            if [[ -d "${APP_CONFIG_ROOT}" ]]; then
              cp -a "${APP_CONFIG_ROOT}/." "${APP_ROOT}/"
              echo "Configuration restored from ${APP_CONFIG_ROOT}."
            else
              echo "WARNING: APP_CONFIG_ROOT (${APP_CONFIG_ROOT}) not found on this instance. Skipping config restore."
            fi

            cat > "${STATE_FILE}" <<STATE
            FIRST_DEPLOY=${FIRST_DEPLOY}
            PREVIOUS_COMMIT=${PREVIOUS_COMMIT}
            NODE_MODULES_BACKUP_CREATED=${NODE_MODULES_BACKUP_CREATED}
            BUILD_BACKUP_CREATED=${BUILD_BACKUP_CREATED}
            STATE

  # JOB 3: INSTALL DEPENDENCIES
  install:
    name: Install dependencies
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [resolve, prepare, pull]
    environment: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.environment }}

    env:
      APP_ROOT: ${{ vars.APP_ROOT }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v6
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Run npm ci
        uses: ./.github/actions/ssm-run
        with:
          phase: Install dependencies
          instance-ids: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.instance_ids }}
          timeout: 900
          script: |
            cd "${APP_ROOT}"
            npm ci

  # JOB 4: BUILD
  build:
    name: Build application
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [resolve, prepare, install]
    environment: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.environment }}

    env:
      APP_ROOT: ${{ vars.APP_ROOT }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v6
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Run npm run build
        uses: ./.github/actions/ssm-run
        with:
          phase: Build application
          instance-ids: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.instance_ids }}
          timeout: 1200
          script: |
            cd "${APP_ROOT}"
            npm run build

  # JOB 5: RESTART
  restart:
    name: Restart application
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [resolve, prepare, build]
    environment: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.environment }}

    env:
      APP_ROOT: ${{ vars.APP_ROOT }}
      APP_PORT: ${{ vars.APP_PORT }}
      PM2_APP_NAME: ${{ vars.PM2_APP_NAME }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v6
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Start or reload PM2
        uses: ./.github/actions/ssm-run
        with:
          phase: Restart application
          instance-ids: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.instance_ids }}
          script: |
            cd "${APP_ROOT}"

            if pm2 describe "${PM2_APP_NAME}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Reloading ${PM2_APP_NAME}..."
              pm2 reload "${PM2_APP_NAME}" --update-env
            else
              echo "Starting ${PM2_APP_NAME}..."
              pm2 start npm \
                --name "${PM2_APP_NAME}" \
                --cwd "${APP_ROOT}" \
                -- start -- -p "${APP_PORT}"
            fi

            pm2 save

  # JOB 6: HEALTH CHECK
  health:
    name: Health check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [resolve, prepare, restart]
    environment: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.environment }}

    env:
      APP_DISPLAY_NAME: ${{ vars.APP_DISPLAY_NAME }}
      APP_ROOT: ${{ vars.APP_ROOT }}
      APP_PORT: ${{ vars.APP_PORT }}
      APP_BASE_PATH: ${{ vars.APP_BASE_PATH }}
      GIT_BRANCH: ${{ vars.GIT_BRANCH }}
      PM2_APP_NAME: ${{ vars.PM2_APP_NAME }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v6
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Check application health
        uses: ./.github/actions/ssm-run
        with:
          phase: Health check
          instance-ids: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.instance_ids }}
          script: |
            for attempt in {1..30}; do
              if curl --fail --silent --show-error "http://127.0.0.1:${APP_PORT}${APP_BASE_PATH}" > /dev/null; then
                echo "Health check passed."
                exit 0
              fi
              echo "Health check attempt ${attempt}/30 failed."
              sleep 2
            done

            echo "ERROR: Health check failed."
            pm2 logs "${PM2_APP_NAME}" --lines 50 --nostream || true
            exit 1

      - name: Delete deployment backups
        uses: ./.github/actions/ssm-run
        with:
          phase: Delete deployment backups
          instance-ids: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.instance_ids }}
          script: |
            if [[ "${NODE_MODULES_BACKUP_CREATED:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
              rm -rf "${NODE_MODULES_BACKUP}"
              echo "Removed node_modules backup."
            fi

            if [[ "${BUILD_BACKUP_CREATED:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
              rm -rf "${BUILD_BACKUP}"
              echo "Removed .next backup."
            fi

      - name: Deployment summary
        run: |
          echo "========================================"
          echo "DEPLOYMENT SUCCESSFUL ON ALL INSTANCES"
          echo "========================================"
          echo "Application: ${APP_DISPLAY_NAME}"
          echo "Branch: ${GIT_BRANCH}"

  # JOB 7: ROLLBACK
  rollback:
    name: Rollback
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [resolve, prepare, pull, install, build, restart, health]
    if: ${{ failure() && needs.pull.result == 'success' }}
    environment: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.environment }}

    env:
      APP_ROOT: ${{ vars.APP_ROOT }}
      APP_PORT: ${{ vars.APP_PORT }}
      APP_BASE_PATH: ${{ vars.APP_BASE_PATH }}
      APP_CONFIG_ROOT: ${{ vars.APP_CONFIG_ROOT }}
      PM2_APP_NAME: ${{ vars.PM2_APP_NAME }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v6
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Roll back to previous version
        uses: ./.github/actions/ssm-run
        with:
          phase: Rollback
          instance-ids: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.instance_ids }}
          script: |
            if [[ "${FIRST_DEPLOY}" == "true" ]]; then
              echo "First-time deploy on this instance (fresh clone)."
              echo "There is no previous working version to roll back to."
              exit 1
            fi

            if [[ "${NODE_MODULES_BACKUP_CREATED}" != "true" ]]; then
              echo "ERROR: No previous node_modules backup exists."
              exit 1
            fi

            cd "${APP_ROOT}"

            echo "Stopping application..."
            pm2 stop "${PM2_APP_NAME}" || true

            echo "Restoring commit ${PREVIOUS_COMMIT}..."
            git reset --hard "${PREVIOUS_COMMIT}"
            git clean -fd

            echo "Restoring node_modules and build output..."
            rm -rf node_modules .next
            mv "${NODE_MODULES_BACKUP}" node_modules

            if [[ "${BUILD_BACKUP_CREATED}" == "true" ]]; then
              mv "${BUILD_BACKUP}" .next
            fi

            echo ""
            echo "Restoring server-specific configuration..."
            if [[ -d "${APP_CONFIG_ROOT}" ]]; then
              cp -a "${APP_CONFIG_ROOT}/." "${APP_ROOT}/"
              echo "Configuration restored from ${APP_CONFIG_ROOT}."
            else
              echo "WARNING: APP_CONFIG_ROOT (${APP_CONFIG_ROOT}) not found on this instance. Skipping config restore."
            fi

            echo "Reloading previous version..."
            if pm2 describe "${PM2_APP_NAME}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              pm2 reload "${PM2_APP_NAME}" --update-env
            else
              pm2 start npm \
                --name "${PM2_APP_NAME}" \
                --cwd "${APP_ROOT}" \
                -- start -- -p "${APP_PORT}"
            fi

            pm2 save

            for attempt in {1..30}; do
              if curl --fail --silent --show-error "http://127.0.0.1:${APP_PORT}${APP_BASE_PATH}" > /dev/null; then
                echo "ROLLBACK SUCCESSFUL. Application restored to ${PREVIOUS_COMMIT}."
                exit 0
              fi
              echo "Rollback health check attempt ${attempt}/30 failed."
              sleep 2
            done

            echo "ROLLBACK FAILED"
            exit 1

name: Run SSM phase
description: Runs a script on EC2 instances through SSM and waits for every instance to finish

inputs:
  phase:
    description: Phase name shown in logs
    required: true

  instance-ids:
    description: Space-separated EC2 instance IDs
    required: true

  script:
    description: Bash script body to run on the instances
    required: true

  timeout:
    description: Seconds to wait for each instance
    required: false
    default: "600"

runs:
  using: composite

  steps:
    - name: Run ${{ inputs.phase }}
      shell: bash

      env:
        PHASE: ${{ inputs.phase }}
        INSTANCE_IDS: ${{ inputs.instance-ids }}
        PHASE_SCRIPT: ${{ inputs.script }}
        TIMEOUT: ${{ inputs.timeout }}

      run: |
        set -euo pipefail

        echo "========================================"
        echo "${PHASE}"
        echo "========================================"
        echo "Target instances: ${INSTANCE_IDS}"

        SCRIPT_FILE="${RUNNER_TEMP}/phase.sh"

        echo '#!/usr/bin/env bash' > "${SCRIPT_FILE}"

        for VAR in \
          APP_DISPLAY_NAME \
          APP_ROOT \
          APP_PORT \
          APP_BASE_PATH \
          APP_CONFIG_ROOT \
          GIT_BRANCH \
          PM2_APP_NAME \
          REPO_URL
        do
          if [[ -n "${!VAR+x}" ]]; then
            printf '%s=%q\n' "${VAR}" "${!VAR}" >> "${SCRIPT_FILE}"
          fi
        done

        cat >> "${SCRIPT_FILE}" <<'PREAMBLE'
        export HOME="/root"
        export NVM_DIR="/root/.nvm"

        if [[ ! -f "${NVM_DIR}/nvm.sh" ]]; then
          echo "ERROR: NVM was not found at ${NVM_DIR}/nvm.sh"
          exit 1
        fi

        source "${NVM_DIR}/nvm.sh"

        nvm use 20 || exit 1

        DEPLOY_NAME="$(basename "${APP_ROOT}")"

        DEPLOY_STATE_ROOT="/var/tmp/deploy-${DEPLOY_NAME}"
        STATE_FILE="${DEPLOY_STATE_ROOT}/state"

        NODE_MODULES_BACKUP="${DEPLOY_STATE_ROOT}/node_modules_backup"
        BUILD_BACKUP="${DEPLOY_STATE_ROOT}/next_backup"

        mkdir -p "${DEPLOY_STATE_ROOT}"

        if [[ -f "${STATE_FILE}" ]]; then
          source "${STATE_FILE}"
        fi

        set -euo pipefail
        PREAMBLE

        printf '%s\n' "${PHASE_SCRIPT}" >> "${SCRIPT_FILE}"

        COMMAND_ID=$(aws ssm send-command \
          --instance-ids ${INSTANCE_IDS} \
          --document-name "AWS-RunShellScript" \
          --comment "${PHASE} ${GITHUB_SHA}" \
          --parameters "$(jq -n \
            --rawfile script "${SCRIPT_FILE}" \
            '{commands: [$script]}')" \
          --query 'Command.CommandId' \
          --output text)

        echo "SSM Command ID: ${COMMAND_ID}"

        FAILED=false

        for INSTANCE_ID in ${INSTANCE_IDS}; do

          echo ""
          echo "----------------------------------------"
          echo "${PHASE} on ${INSTANCE_ID}"
          echo "----------------------------------------"

          STATUS="Pending"
          DEADLINE=$((SECONDS + TIMEOUT))

          while (( SECONDS < DEADLINE )); do

            STATUS=$(aws ssm get-command-invocation \
              --command-id "${COMMAND_ID}" \
              --instance-id "${INSTANCE_ID}" \
              --query 'Status' \
              --output text 2>/dev/null || echo "Pending")

            case "${STATUS}" in
              Success|Failed|Cancelled|Cancelling|TimedOut)
                break
                ;;
            esac

            sleep 5
          done

          echo ""
          echo "Output from ${INSTANCE_ID}:"

          aws ssm get-command-invocation \
            --command-id "${COMMAND_ID}" \
            --instance-id "${INSTANCE_ID}" \
            --query 'StandardOutputContent' \
            --output text || true

          ERRORS=$(aws ssm get-command-invocation \
            --command-id "${COMMAND_ID}" \
            --instance-id "${INSTANCE_ID}" \
            --query 'StandardErrorContent' \
            --output text || true)

          if [[ -n "${ERRORS}" && "${ERRORS}" != "None" ]]; then
            echo ""
            echo "Error output:"
            echo "${ERRORS}"
          fi

          if [[ "${STATUS}" != "Success" ]]; then
            echo "::error::${PHASE} failed on ${INSTANCE_ID} (status: ${STATUS})"
            FAILED=true
          fi

        done

        if [[ "${FAILED}" == "true" ]]; then
          exit 1
        fi

# GlobalRates

GlobalRates is a live currency exchange-rate checker — a clean, dark trading-style dashboard for seeing what any currency is really worth at the mid-market rate. It's built as a demo of APILayer's data APIs: the whole experience, from the converter to the charts to the news feed, is driven by real APILayer data.

Open the site and it detects your location and defaults to comparing your local currency against the US Dollar. From there you can convert any amount between 170+ currencies, scan quick-reference rate tables, read a 12-month price chart, browse financial news relevant to the pair you're viewing, and jump between popular pairs — all updating together.

It's a rate-checking tool, not a money-transfer service: the mid-market rate shown is the fair reference rate banks and businesses use, for informational purposes.

## What powers it

Everything runs on APILayer APIs, proxied through server routes in `app/api/` so keys stay off the client:

- **[Exchange Rates Data API](https://exchangeratesapi.io/)** — real-time and historical FX for the converter, the conversion tables, the candlestick chart (via `timeseries`) and the popular-pairs moves (via `fluctuation`).
- **[Mediastack](https://mediastack.com/)** — the financial news section, keyword-filtered to the selected currency pair and cached so it stays within the request quota.
- **[ipstack](https://ipstack.com/)** — geolocates the visitor on first load to choose the default local currency (USD stays the anchor; nothing is hardcoded).

## Getting started

Create a `.env.local` in the project root with your APILayer keys:

```bash
# Exchange Rates Data API
EXCHANGERATES_API_KEY=your_key
EXCHANGERATES_API_BASE_URL=http://api.exchangeratesapi.io/v1

# Mediastack (news)
MEDIASTACK_API_KEY=your_key
MEDIASTACK_API_BASE_URL=http://api.mediastack.com/v1

# ipstack (geo default currency)
IPSTACK_ACCESS_KEY=your_key
```

Then run the dev server:

```bash
npm run dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000).

> **Note on local geolocation:** running locally, there's no real visitor IP, so ipstack geolocates the server's outbound IP. In production behind a proxy (with `x-forwarded-for`) it resolves each visitor accurately.

If a key is missing or rate-limited, the affected section degrades gracefully — the converter falls back to a neutral USD/EUR default, news and geo return empty rather than erroring, and cached results are served when the upstream is briefly unavailable.
